answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through correlated slashing. Each agent locks a bond to gain a vote; if many identities collude, the penalty grows with the square of the number involved. Splitting one fortune into a thousand fake agents does not dilute blame, it multiplies it, so the attack costs far more than any votes it buys. Honest agents still tend their garden of work and earn steady rewards, while a cheater's quartz-hard stake is destroyed and the horizon of profit collapses.
